description: This file extends the AttributedString class to include a method that segments the attributed string into sentences based on linguistic tokenizer outputs, optionally limiting sentence length, and associates audio time ranges with each sentence.

classes.name: AttributedString
classes.description: A sequence of styled text segments, extended here to include sentence segmentation with audio timing attributes.

methods.name: sentences(maxLength:)
methods.description: Returns an array of AttributedString objects, each representing a sentence or segment of the original attributed string, optionally constrained by maxLength, and with associated audio time ranges.
